content.comment_body: I've installed [product_name] version 5 and 6 on Windows 7. When I try to save a project, the application stops responding. How can I resolve this issue? Best regards, [user_name]
Are you using the official full version of [product_name], or a demo version? You might want to try a free upgrade—check the Help section in your application.

Hello, [product_name] versions 5 and 6 are not fully compatible with Windows 7. Sometimes they work, other times they don’t. For information about updates and installation of the newer version, you should look into how to install version 7 without needing previous versions. You will need a full previous version to install the upgrade. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering problems saving projects with [product_name] versions 5 and 6 on Windows 7, and the software becomes unresponsive. Compatibility issues are the main concern, since these older versions do not consistently work on newer operating systems. Users are also uncertain if using full or demo versions makes a difference, and want guidance on upgrading the software for better reliability.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to function smoothly on Windows 7, particularly for saving projects, without running into freezing or blocking issues.
